title: a hunk whose trailing context reaches an unterminated last line, without a sentinel, terminates the file
notes: §12 item 23: the anchor block includes the file's last line `b`, so the hunk reaches the end of file and its new side decides; no sentinel was recorded, so the last line is terminated ('a previously unterminated last line gains a terminator'), although the original last line is still last. Compare `eof-edit-elsewhere-keeps-unterminated`, where no hunk reaches the end of file.
